texts.preamble: Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth vs Vadodara Municipal Corpn on 14 June, 2017 Author: Paresh Upadhyay Bench: Paresh Upadhyay C/Sca/19748/2007 Cav O In The High Court Of Gujarat At Ahmedabad Special Civil Application No. 19748 of 2007 ============================================ Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth ....Petitioner Versus Vadodara Municipal Corpn. @ Vadodara Mahanagar Seva Sadan & Ors ....Respondents = = = = = = = ============= Appearance: Petitioner in Person Ms Rina Kamani, Advocate (for petitioner, at the request of the Court) Mr. Parth H Bhatt, Advocate for the Respondent - Corporation M R R A S H E S H R I N D A N I , A G P f o r t h e R e s p o n d e n t s N o . 3 - 4 = = = ============= Coram: Honourable Mr.Justice Paresh Upadhyay Date : 14/06/2017 Cav Order 1.
texts.facts: Challenge in this petition is made to the removal order dated 20.09.2005. The petitioner was an employee of the respondent Vadodara Municipal Corporation. For proved misconduct in departmental inquiry, he is imposed major punishment of removal from service vide order dated 20.09.2005. Appeal against the said order is also rejected by the Appellate Authority vide order dated 10.11.2005. It is this removal which is questioned in this petition. 2.1 The petitioner, who appeared in person, has addressed the Court almost for the whole days on 08.09.2017, HC-NIC Page 1 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13:53 IST 2017 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER 09.06.2017 and 12.06.2017. This aspect is noted by this Court, in the orders of the respective dates. Pursuant to the said order, Ms. Rina Kamani, learned advocate has appeared in this matter and she has also addressed this Court on behalf of the petitioner. The present petitioner had filed Special Civil Application No.6665 of 2001. "1. The petitioner has filed this petition under Article 226 of the Constitution of India praying for the direction to the respondents to pay the petitioner all back wages, allowances, fees etc. for entire period of the petitioner's absence from duty as well as the period spent on duty and all other regular service benefits etc., if any, as Food Inspector with 18% compound interest w.e.f. HC-NIC Page 9 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER 04.12.1997. The petitioner has also prayed for the similar relief w.e.f. 30.05.1995 maintaining seniority of the petitioner in the cadre of Food Inspector. 2. This Court has passed an order on 17.08.2001 issuing notice. 3. The petitioner, therefore, filed L.P.A. No. 1191 of 2001 before this Court. The petitioner thereafter moved Civil Application No. 10232 of 2005 challenging the order of removal dated 20.09.2005 passed by the Municipal Commissioner, Vadodara Municipal Corporation. The said petition came to be dismissed without any order as to costs. "This review application is filed by party-in- person to review the order dated 27.3.2008 passed in Civil Application No.3799/2008, on the ground that the order passed in Civil Application is in contravention of Articles 12, 13/2, 14, 16, 20, 21, 23, 311(1), 311(2), and first proviso and all principles of natural justice is illegal, void, ex-parte, HC-NIC Page 20 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13:53 IST 2017 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER arbitrary, unconstitutional manner on the ground of all fairness. "1. This is a contempt petition filed and pursued by party-in-person. At the time of his oral submissions, party-in-person submitted that the contempt petition alleges breach of as many as 11 judgments passed by the High Courts. Obviously, since such multiple causes of action Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth vs Vadodara Municipal Corpn on 14 June, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156045523/ 11 cannot be combined in one single proceeding , we requested the party-in-person to choose any one judgment for which, the present contempt petition can be confined. He stated that he would be arguing breach of the directions contained in order dated 17.01.1997 passed by the Division Bench of this Court in Letters Patent Appeal No.513 of 1996, copy of which order is produced at HC-NIC Page 21 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13:53 IST 2017 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER page 251.
texts.arguments: 2.4 Mr.Rashesh Rindani, learned Assistant Government Pleader appeared on behalf of the State Authorities, which are formal respondents. 3. Though the petitioner has raised various grievances, the subject matter of this petition, as noted above is, the order dated 20.09.2005 whereby the petitioner is removed from service of the Corporation as Junior Clerk and therefore the legality of the said order is only examined in this petition. 4. It is noted that though the petitioner has addressed the Court at length for days, no specific contention is raised with regard to the impugned order dated 20.09.2005. His entire thrust was on the point that, he ought to have been continued as Food Inspector and not as Junior Clerk. 5. Ms.Rina Kamani, learned advocate has also taken this Court through the material on record to attempt to point out, as to how the petitioner is aggrieved by the various actions of the respondent Corporation. Since there is no specific contention with regard to the impugned order dated 20.09.2005, even Ms.Kamani, learned advocate has not been able to show any specific point in that regard. 6. Mr.Parth Bhatt, learned advocate for the respondent Corporation has drawn the attention of this Court to two affidavits in reply. 7. Having heard the petitioner in person, Ms.Kamani, learned advocate (for the petitioner), Mr.Bhatt, learned advocate for the respondent - Corporation and having considered the material on record, this Court finds as under. 7.1 2. The appellant who appears as a party in person however submits that if the interim relief as prayed for is not granted, the appellant will be required to join as a Junior Clerk and all his rights and contentions raised in the main petition are likely to be prejudiced if he resumes duty as a Junior Clerk. HC-NIC Page 8 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00: C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV O 3. The petitioner has pointed out that the order of Division Bench is challenged before the Hon'ble Supreme Court and Special Leave Petitions were admitted and stay is granted against the implementation and operation of the order. He has Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth vs Vadodara Municipal Corpn on 14 June, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156045523/ 7 produced the copy of the order passed by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in HC-NIC Page 13 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13:53 IST 2017 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER SLP (Civil) Nos. 5454-5455 of 2001 dated 04.02.2002 and 26.08.2002. 4. Though the learned advocate as well as the appellant have argued at length to the effect that the appellant should have been continued as Food Inspector, looking to the sound reasons stated by the learned Single Judge, it is very clear that the appellant had no right to continue in the cadre of Food Inspector. 5. During the pendency of the litigation, service of the appellant as Junior Clerk has been terminated vide an order dated 20th HC-NIC Page 16 of 23 Created On Thu Jun 15 00:13:53 IST 2017 C/SCA/19748/2007 CAV ORDER September, 2005 passed by the Municipal Commissioner, Vadodara Municipal Corporation, which has been sought to be challenged by moving a Civil Application, being Civil Application No. 10232 of 2005. The learned Single Judge has rightly held that the issue raised in the said Civil Application had given rise to a fresh cause of action, which could not have been decided in the said petition. The said petition was preferred by the present petitioner to challenge the order passed by the Deputy Municipal Dineshkumar Mohanlal Sheth vs Vadodara Municipal Corpn on 14 June, 2017 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/156045523/ 9 Mr.Pranav G.Desai, learned advocate for the respondent no.3, Baroda Municipal Corporation states that the respondent Corporation will make a proposal within one month from to day for notifying the Food Inspectors. Mr.D.A.Bambhania, learned Advocate for the State Government states that the State Government will take decision on the said proposed within two months thereafter.
